HEADLINE: UN Security Council schedules emergency session on Sudan ceasefire
DATELINE: UNITED NATIONS
BODY:
The UN Security Council will hold an emergency session on Thursday to discuss the collapsing ceasefire in Sudan, diplomats said, after renewed fighting around El Fasher killed dozens of civilians.

The session was requested by several council members after aid agencies said
convoys had been unable to reach the city for more than a week.

A spokesperson for the UN secretary-general called on all parties to return to
the truce agreed last month.
